title: Modular Bayesian Inference for Partially Misspecified Mixtures with Uncertain Class Labels
abstract: arXiv:2610.27085v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific inference often involves observations from multiple latent populations whose class memberships are uncertain and must be inferred from available data. While full Bayesian mixture modelling provides a principled approach to joint uncertainty quantification in this setting, often the model is misspecified or less trustworthy for populations that are not the target of the inference, which can distort posterior inference for the parameters of interest. We propose a modular Bayesian framework that safeguards against such biases. We decouple classification from downstream inference using fixed class probabilities, for example from a classifier trained on a subset of labelled data. We then protect inference on the parameters of interest by preventing the likelihood contributions of less trustworthy populations from influencing them. translated_title: 面向类别标签不确定且部分误设混合模型的模块化贝叶斯推断
translated_abstract: 科学推断常常涉及来自多个潜在总体的观测数据，这些数据的类别归属是未知的，需要从可用数据中推断。虽然完整的贝叶斯混合模型为这一场景下的联合不确定性量化提供了一种有原则的方法，但当模型对于非推断目标的总体存在误设或可信度较低时，可能会扭曲对感兴趣参数的后验推断。我们提出了一个模块化贝叶斯框架来防范此类偏差。我们利用固定的类别概率（例如来自在带标签数据子集上训练的分类器）将分类与下游推断解耦；进而通过阻止可信度较低的总体的似然贡献影响推断结果，来保护对感兴趣参数的推断。这种有原则的模块化的一个关键优势在于它极大地简化了推断过程。
tldr: 提出一种模块化贝叶斯框架，通过固定类别概率将分类与下游推断解耦，并隔离可信度较低总体对似然的贡献，从而防止模型部分误设对目标参数后验推断的扭曲，同时大幅简化推断过程。
en_tdlr: A modular Bayesian framework that decouples classification from downstream inference using fixed class probabilities and shields parameters of interest from the likelihood contributions of less trustworthy populations, guarding against bias from partial model misspecification while greatly simplifying inference.
